Read 10x Genomics Gene Expression Sample(s) into Seurat Objects

Source: R/seuratFrom10x.R
seuratFrom10x.Rd

Reads one or more samples' filtered feature barcode matrix H5 files from 10x Genomics Cell Ranger output and creates one Seurat object per sample. Supports both cellranger count output (one sample per run) and cellranger multi output (one or more demuxed samples under outs/per_sample_outs/), specified either as a single path or as a manifest describing multiple runs.

Usage

seuratFrom10x(
  manifest = NULL,
  path = NULL,
  multi = NULL,
  min.cells = 10,
  min.features = 50,
  multiplexed = NULL
)

Arguments

manifest

Data frame with columns Path (character; path to each run's outs/ directory) and multi (logical). Rows may mix the two pipelines freely. Mutually exclusive with path.

path

Character string. Path to a single Cell Ranger outs/ directory. Mutually exclusive with manifest.

multi

Logical. Whether path was produced by cellranger multi rather than cellranger count – see the section above. Required when path is supplied; ignored when manifest is supplied, since the pipeline is read per-row from manifest$multi instead.

min.cells

Integer. Include features detected in at least this many cells. Passed to Seurat::CreateSeuratObject().

min.features

Integer. Include cells where at least this many features are detected. Passed to Seurat::CreateSeuratObject().

multiplexed

Deprecated. The former name of multi; still accepted, with a warning.

Value

A named list of Seurat objects, one per sample, each with the RNA assay and an Ident metadata column set to the sample name. List names match sample identifiers. Samples whose expected H5 file is missing are dropped from the manifest-mode result with a warning; in path mode, a missing file raises an error instead.

Details

Exactly one of manifest or path must be supplied.

Which pipeline wrote the run

multi selects the output layout, and the two Cell Ranger pipelines produce different ones:

multi = FALSE

cellranger count, which writes outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 for its single sample.

multi = TRUE

cellranger multi, which writes outs/per_sample_outs/<sample>/count/sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 for each sample it demuxed.

The distinction is which pipeline ran, not how many samples came out of it. cellranger multi writes per_sample_outs/ even when it demultiplexed a single sample – the usual case for Flex and 5' runs – so those need multi = TRUE despite not being multiplexed in any biological sense. That is why the argument is no longer called multiplexed.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# A `cellranger count` run
seurat_list <- seuratFrom10x(
  path  = "/path/to/Sample_1/outs",
  multi = FALSE
)

# A `cellranger multi` run, expanding to one object per demuxed sample
seurat_list <- seuratFrom10x(
  path  = "/path/to/Pool1/outs",
  multi = TRUE
)

# Manifest describing several runs from either pipeline
manifest <- data.frame(
  Path  = c("/path/to/Sample_1/outs", "/path/to/Pool1/outs"),
  multi = c(FALSE, TRUE)
)
seurat_list <- seuratFrom10x(manifest = manifest, min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
} # }
